note: Манифест арт-пакета. Промпт = promptSuffix с подстановкой subject, референс стиля = art/style-test/flowershop-keyart.png. После генерации: .venv/bin/python tools/cutout.py art/raw/<id>.png --outdir art/sprites, затем tools/check-sprites.py. Все цепочки — по 10 уровней.

style.promptSuffix: Isolated single {SUBJECT}, centered, soft 3/4 view, cozy painterly storybook illustration matching the reference art style, pastel palette (sage green #9DBE9A, cream #F3EADB, dusty rose #E98C9B, warm wood #C89A63, lavender #A99BD4), clean readable silhouette, warm light from upper left, plain flat uniform light gray background filling the entire frame, object fully inside the frame with generous margin, no cast shadow on ground, no other objects, no people, no text, no letters.

done: 6 зданий (bld-flowershop, bld-coffee, bld-bakery, bld-workshop, bld-greenhouse, bld-pavilion)
progress.note: арт-пакет MVP закрыт. Дальше: звук, анимации, сезонные цепочки событий
